fact_text: The used-car import age limit was raised from three years to five years, which widens the pool of eligible used imports.

fact_text: Maximum protection for locally assembled cars against used imports is about 40% in the first year under the IMF agreement, and it is phased down to 0% over roughly four years.

fact_text: Used-car imports pay a fixed amount per vehicle that depreciates monthly by vehicle age, so the effective percentage duty falls as the car gets older.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Auto Sector - Imported Cars are Coming? Slow Death of Auto Sector has started?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Duties on imported cars are set by engine-size band; regulatory duty is nil below 1000cc, while customs and regulatory duties stack so the combined burden rises steeply above 1800cc and 2500cc.

fact_text: The budget speech announced that regulatory duties will be removed over five years and customs duties cut over about four years, with more than 1,000 regulated duty categories going to 0%.

fact_text: The price gap between locally assembled cars and cheaper used imports, not the policy headline, decides whether buyers switch, so the landed-cost comparison is what to watch.

fact_text: The analyst's method is to add customs duty, regulatory duty, sales tax and other levies to the import price of each candidate car, then compare the landed cost with the locally assembled rival in the same engine band.

fact_text: The analyst's working assumption is that imported used cars in the higher engine-size categories would face a maximum duty near 75% under the agreement, compared with a much lower duty on locally assembled kits.

fact_text: Cheaper used imports do not drain the import bill out of control when prices sit near local car prices, because demand for cars grows only in line with normal demand and total spend rises only modestly, the analyst argues.
